# Read of unit U1, goal a-seat-moves-its-own-note (round 1)

Subject: the diff of U1 against base d427a9e1f39b06bca5653ac51257233811b2c57f, judged against build-brief.md (FINAL revision 2).
The read diff (`read.diff`) is byte-identical to the candidate `worktree.diff` (SHA-256 21b6ad7e…c641, checked). The worktree's `git diff d427a9e1f` matches both, except for the index lines.

## AGREE

No material findings.

## Checklist item 1: every required change is present, correct and tested, and nothing outside it changed

Scope. Four files changed, the four the Units table names: `internal/goal/readitems.go` (production), `internal/goal/readitems_authority_test.go` (test A), `cmd/metasystem/intent_planning_test.go` (test B) and `testing.json`. In total 160 lines were added and 9 deleted. Production is +26/-9 (35 changed lines), against the brief's estimate of 37 and its table limit of 240. No other production file changed.

Production, as the brief's "What changes" section asks:
- `movedNoteAdmitted(source, target, actor)` (readitems.go:119-129) is true only when `source.State == StateClaimed`, `ownPair(source.Claimed, actor)`, `target.State == StateParked`, and `target.Blocked` names `source.Id`. This matches item 1 exactly.
- In `closeReadItem` (readitems.go:310-321), when the helper returns true, the target's `authorizeReadItemChange` call is skipped and `targetDisplaced` stays `""`. Otherwise the call runs as before. The source check (readitems.go:277) is unchanged apart from its new sentence argument. Skipping the target call loses nothing: that function's foreign-claim branch and its `pairMarker` displacement only apply to claimed goals, and the target here is parked.
- `authorizeReadItemChange` now takes the parked sentence from its caller. The row `Name` ("read items on a parked goal") and the terminal grade did not change. All four sentences match the brief word for word:
  - add (:179): "Goal <id> is parked; only a person can add a note to it."
  - close (:277): "Goal <id> is parked; only a person can close its notes."
  - move, when the actor holds the source (:314): "Goal <target> does not wait for <source>; only a person can move this note there."
  - move, any other source (:312): "Goal <target> is parked; only a person can move this note there."
- `Edit`'s parked rule (verbs.go:3979-3981) did not change, so the target's own fields still need a person.
- The old read-item words appeared only at readitems.go:109; the Edit words at verbs.go:3980 stay. No other Go caller or test depended on the old read-item words (grepped). `authorizeReadItemChange` has only the three call sites, and all three were updated.
- The new sentences contain no term that `TestAuditMessagesAPersonReads` bans (cmd/metasystem/message_audit_test.go:118-134). The frozen check's `^TestAudit` run is green.

Test A, `TestASeatMovesItsOwnNoteToTheGoalThatWaitsForIt`, follows the brief's setup:
- held is claimed by mac-a/lin-1. follow-up and follow-up-2 are opened with `OpenRisked` by a proven person and blocked by held and by queued-src.
- paused is parked by a person with terminal authority.
- The test checks that follow-up is unapproved and parked before T1, and still unapproved after T1, before T3.

All of T1, T2a, T2b, T3 and T4 are present and assert what the brief requires: the outcome, the source row set to `moved`, one open material "(moved from held)" row on follow-up, the park record, blockers, intent and next step unchanged, no `displaced=`, and the exact refusal words. Every refusal also checks that the ledger is unchanged (`snapshotTerminalLedger`).

Test B, `TestIntentPlanningNotesMoveOntoAnApprovedFollowUp`, drives the real `goal notes <bedGoal> --close r3-1 --moved follow-up` command:
- It runs with `bed.owners()` on lineage m1, against a follow-up that is parked, blocked by the held goal and approved. The test checks the approval survives projection before it acts.
- It asserts exit 0 and `intentConfirmed`, one publication, exactly one open note with the moved text, `Approved` and `Parked` deep-equal to before, and the source's last history line as `mac-cli+m1` with no `displaced=`.
- The repeat gives exit 0 and `intentUnchanged`, with no second publication and still one note.

Registration. Both names were appended to `goal-decision-standard` (testing.json:62). The group's packages (internal/goal, cmd/metasystem) contain both tests. Nothing else in testing.json changed.

## Checklist item 2: the proof's tests exercise the changed behavior, not only the happy path

The proof command is `/usr/bin/true` and runs nothing itself (see observation 3). The evidence comes from the round's frozen check and from runs made during this read.

Frozen check (round-1/check-1717232611/output.log), all green:
- `LANDING-CHECKED 0`
- unit/internal/goal
- unit/cmd/metasystem
- command-interface-smoke
- the `^TestAudit` run

Runs during this read, on the unmodified worktree, all PASS:
- internal/goal: `TestASeatMovesItsOwnNoteToTheGoalThatWaitsForIt`, `TestReadItemChangesOnProtectedGoalsNeedAProvenPerson`, `TestReadItemsMoveIsAtomicAndRefusesDoneTarget` and `TestReadItemsCloseRepeatsAndRefusesAnotherDisposition`.
- cmd/metasystem: `TestIntentPlanningNotesMoveOntoAnApprovedFollowUp` and `TestIntentPlanningNotesAuthority`.

I ran each brief mutation through `go test -overlay`, so the worktree was not edited. The overlays and logs are in /tmp/u1read-mut/. Each mutation fails the case the brief names:

| Mutation | Fails | Observed failure |
|---|---|---|
| M1 (helper always false) | T1 and B | T1 is rejected; B exits 1 with "refused" and the incident's words |
| M2a (holder clause always true) | T2a | the unheld source's move is confirmed |
| M2b (source's foreign-claim refusal deleted) | T2b | the refusal carries the target's words instead of "is claimed by mac-a+lin-1" |
| M3 (`Blocked` clause dropped) | T4 | the move onto the unrelated pause is confirmed |
| M4 (Edit's parked branch deleted) | T3 | the parked target's intent edit is confirmed |
| M5 (old words restored) | T4's text | the refusal text no longer matches |

The tests cover the refusal paths and the repeat as well as the admitted move.

## Non-gating observations

1. Low. readitems_authority_test.go:81 (T2b) builds its request with a hand-typed 27-character ULID, `"01J5X0000000000000000000032"`. Its siblings use `readItemRequest`'s 26-character `fmt.Sprintf("01J5X%021d", n)`. It does no harm, because the request is refused before anything is published. `verbReqFor(endpoint, fmt.Sprintf("01J5X%021d", 32), "mac-b")` would match the rest of the test. RELATION: new
2. Low. The new skip at readitems.go:310-321 has no comment. The only nearby rule comment is in `authorizeReadItemChange` ("Changing ... a parked goal is a person's act"), and the call site now makes an exception to it without saying so. Code nearby comments its rules this way (for example, the repeat-close comment at :292-294). One line such as "A holder may move its note onto a goal that waits for it; nothing else on that goal changes" would help a later reader. RELATION: new
3. Observation on item 2, outside the diff. The unit's proof command `/usr/bin/true` exercises nothing. The changed behavior is covered by the frozen unit check and by the mutation runs above. RELATION: new

## Budget

Every checklist item was checked within the tool-call budget. Nothing was left unchecked.

VERDICT: land
